scientific_intent.independent_validation: Complex128 finite difference/vector calculus, normalized NumPy FFT and Hermitian Gram-eigen functional nuclear proximal (not sourceSVD replay). Allfield/tracebudgets predeclared, originalGPUstagebodies preserved.
